environment: Node VM using the shipped controller, reader handlers and scroll-tracking function; browser checks are separate

results.name: Saved dark appearance applies in the head before the body exists
Device preference follows system changes until a reader makes an explicit choice
One tap synchronizes selected buttons, both settings menus and the browser color
A selected theme survives reload and carries between Nitnem and Japji palettes
Legacy per-bani preference migrates only once and cannot replace the shared choice
Readers without a legacy choice keep following the device after reload
An appearance change in another tab updates this view without writing again
Clearing the shared preference resumes the current device preference
Blocked local storage still allows theme switching and reports the saving limit
Invalid preferences cannot become CSS themes or overwrite other learning data
Nitnem theme events preserve newer learning saved by another tab
Both reader documents provide labeled native buttons before opening any menu
Nitnem scroll tracking chooses a line below a wrapped persistent header
Japji theme events and its settings selector leave learning persistence untouched
